events.description: Puerto Rican music icon Ednita Nazario returns to the stage with her FuegoAlmaVida Tour. events.name: Florida Grand Opera: Viva Verdi
events.venue: Au-Rene Theater at the Broward Center, Ft Lauderdale
events.description: Viva Verdi! The Best of Verdi! From the thunderous choruses of Nabucco to the heartbreaking arias of La Traviata, Rigoletto, and Aida, this concert brings together the music that made Verdi the most beloved composer in opera history. Full orchestra and a powerhouse roster of singers join forces for an evening that spans Verdi's entire career - love, betrayal, triumph, and tragedy, all in his unmistakable voice. No plot, no staging - just Verdi's greatest hits, performed with the passion that has filled opera houses for over 150 years.

events.venue: Aventura Arts & Cultural Center, Aventura
events.description: Dance NOW! Miami Presents Program III, featuring "Oceanica and other works." Co-Artistic Director Diego Salterini plunges audiences into the ocean's dual nature-its breathtaking power and delicate vulnerability-through a contemporary dance and kinetic meditation on marine life. The full ensemble embodies marine life through movement blending ballet's precision, modern dance's depth, and jazz's energy, journeying from ocean depths to surface in a celebration of this biodiverse ecosystem.
